title: कक्षा दुईको नेपाली भाषा पाठयपुस्तक (२०७६) को अध्ययन {Kakshya Duiko Nepali Bhasha Pathyapustak (2076) ko Adhyayan}
authors: घिमिरे Ghimire, तुलसा देवी Tulasa Devi
nepali: शोधपत्रको शीर्षक : कक्षा दुईको नेपाली भाषापाठ्यपुस्तक (२०७६) को अध्ययन शोध निर्देशक  : तीर्थराज भट्टराइ शोधाथी : तुलसा देवी घिमिरे क्याम्पस विभाग : जनता बहुमुखी क्याम्पस, इटहरी, सुनसरी शैक्षिक वष : २०६८\६९ पृष्ठ सङ्ख्या : ४९+९ अध्याय  : पाँच उद्देश्य : यस शोधपत्रका उद्देश्यहरू कक्षा दुइको नेपाली भाषा पाठ्यपुस्तकको बाह्य तथा आन्तरिक विशेषताका आधारमा विश्लेषण गर्ने । शोध विधि :यो शोधपत्र तयार पार्नको लागि वर्णनात्मक र विश्लेषणात्मक विधिको प्रयोग गरिएको छ । निष्कर्ष : कक्षा दुइको नेपाली भाषा पाठ्यपुस्तकको बाह्य तथा आन्तरिक विशेषताका आधारमा विश्लेषण गरी पाठ्यपुस्तकका आन्तरिक, प्राज्ञिक पक्षमा क–कति राम्रा र नराम्रा पक्षहरू छन् भनी निष्कर्ष निकालिएको छ ।
american_english:
Title of the research paper: A Study of the Nepali Language Textbook of Class Two (2076)
Research adviser: Tirtharaj Bhattarai
Researcher: Tulasa Devi Ghimire
Campus/Department: Janata Multiple Campus, Itahari, Sunsari
Academic year: 2068/69
Number of pages: 49 + 9
Chapters: five
Objectives: The objectives of this research paper are to analyze the Nepali language textbook of class two on the basis of its external and internal characteristics.
Research method: To prepare this research paper, a descriptive and analytical method has been used.
Conclusion: By analyzing the Nepali language textbook of class two on the basis of its external and internal characteristics, a conclusion has been drawn as to how good and bad the internal, academic aspects of the textbook are.

informal_english: Right, so this one's called 'A Study of the Nepali Language Textbook of Class Two (2076).' Tulasa Devi Ghimire did it, supervised by Tirtharaj Bhattarai, out of Janata Multiple Campus, Itahari, Sunsari, in 2068/69. It's five chapters, 49 plus 9 pages. The aim was to analyse the class two Nepali language textbook on its external and internal characteristics, using a descriptive and analytical method, and the conclusion draws out how good and bad the internal, academic aspects of the textbook are.
